info.name: Stark Bank Balance Event Attempt API
List failed Webhook Event delivery attempts

params.name: after
params.description: Filter entities created after this date.

params.name: before
params.description: Filter entities created before this date.

params.name: cursor
params.description: String used to get the next batch of results. Our SDKs handle this for you.

params.name: eventIds
params.description: List of Event ids to filter attempts. Example: ["5656565656565656", "4545454545454545"]

params.name: fields
params.description: List of strings to filter response JSON keys. Not available in the SDKs.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results per cursor. Max = 100.

params.name: webhookIds
params.description: list of Webhook ids to filter attempts. Example: ["5656565656565656", "4545454545454545"]

items.docs: Get information on failed webhook event delivery attempts.
